title: Verify: Token values come from the palette and Tailwind exposes them
summary: Unit tests for tokens and Tailwind config
description: Test tokens against PALETTE and the Tailwind config exports.
acceptance_criteria: Every colour token is in PALETTE
Tailwind config exposes sf theme values referencing CSS vars
technical_constraints: All dependencies mocked; unit tests only

steps.action: Add test 'colour tokens come from the palette': flatten Object.values(COLOR_TOKENS) and assert every hex is in PALETTE. Add test 'css vars': call tokensToCssVars and assert it has --sf-color-brass-4 equal to PALETTE_RAMPS.brass[3], --sf-space-2 equal to '8px' and --sf-font-pixel containing 'Press Start 2P'.

Import tailwind.config; assert theme.extend.colors.sf['brass-4'] (or the structure A1 wrote) is 'var(--sf-color-brass-4)', theme.extend.spacing['sf-2'] is 'var(--sf-space-2)', fontFamily.pixel is 'var(--sf-font-pixel)', colors.background still 'hsl(var(--background))'.
steps.expected: Test passes and the existing paletteTailwind test is unaffected
